unit_label: BRBL::MOD_D::U27: Distinguish unauthorised computer acts,adjudication and appeal

payload.title: Access permission and the particular act both matter
payload.core_explanation_md:
The source identifies unauthorised access, copying, extraction, disruption, damage and other specified computer acts within the section 43 compensation framework. Permission to perform one task is not necessarily permission to extract all data or alter another account. Distinguish a contravention remedy from the separate offence and mental-element requirements; do not classify every incident through a single penalty label.

The described appeal from the Controller/adjudicating-officer order goes to TDSAT within45 days from receipt of the copy, with the stated sufficient-cause extension and consent-order exception. Criminal investigation has its own authorised-officer rule. Preserve permissions, logs, record versions and order-receipt evidence rather than relying only on an allegation that the system was hacked.

self_check.prompt_text: Does permission for a routine task automatically permit copying every database?
self_check.expected_takeaway: No. The scope of permission and the particular act matter.

payload.stem_md: An employee has permission to view one customer file but copies a separate restricted database. Which fact is material to the IT-law analysis?

options.text_md: The scope of permission for the actual copying act
options.explanation_md: Some access permission is not unlimited authorisation.

options.text_md: Only whether the employee has an identity card
options.explanation_md: Employment alone does not authorise every act.

options.text_md: Whether the copied data was interesting

payload.correct_explanation_md: Some access permission is not unlimited authorisation.

payload.stem_md: An aggrieved party challenges a qualifying adjudicating-officer order under the described appeal route. Which forum and ordinary filing period apply?

options.explanation_md: That is not the described statutory appeal.

options.text_md: TDSAT,45 days from receipt of the order copy
options.explanation_md: The source states that forum and trigger, subject to qualifications.
A branch is not the statutory tribunal.

payload.correct_explanation_md: The source states that forum and trigger, subject to qualifications.
